name: Rule unification: config repo A0–A2 (freeze, ESLint 8→9, extract & publish packages)
description:
**Repo: **`shoptet/addon-repository-actions-config` (not this CLI repo). Source of truth: `doc/plans/rule-unification.md` in `shoptet-partner-cli`.

## Why

`shoptet validate` and the config repo's deploy gate run unrelated rule sets today (ESLint overlap 3/40, Stylelint overlap 0). This slice makes the config repo's rules the published, single authority both runners will consume.

## What

- **A0** — land in-flight branches and freeze the rule set before extraction starts.
- **A1** — migrate ESLint 8 → 9 to flat config, and fix the `cwd`/basePath behaviour the CLI's `eslint.ts` depends on (see B1).
- **A2** — extract and publish three packages under the `@shoptet` scope:

  - `@shoptet/addon-eslint-config` — flat config, the 8 `shoptet/*` rules, `RELIABLE_RULES` as a named export, peer range `>=9.5.0 <11`.
  - `@shoptet/addon-stylelint-config` — config, the 4 plugin rules, its allowlist slice, peer range `>=15 <18`.
  - `@shoptet/addon-html-lint` — the 3 parse5 checks (`html/no-inline-script`, `a11y/img-alt`, `html/deprecated-tag`).
  - `@eslint/js` must be a pinned regular dependency, never a peer (it doesn't track eslint's version).
  - The shared config must enumerate its rules explicitly — never spread `js.configs.recommended` (61 rules on ESLint 9 vs 64 on ESLint 10; spreading it makes the package produce different findings on each side).

## Blocked on

- **npm publish rights in the **`@shoptet` scope — held by SOFA/g4 maintainers (`janvoracek`, `shoptet-ci`). A2 cannot complete without this access. This is an access conversation, not a pipeline to build — the scope already has a working OIDC publish path (`@shoptet/ui`).
- `fix/large-file-inline-comments` is changing the rule set right now (makes `max-lines` a blocker, drops warnings from inline comments) — this is exactly why A0 exists; whoever owns that branch needs to know an extraction is coming.

## Definition of done

Three packages published from the config repo at real semver versions; this repo's B1 slice can `pnpm add` them.
